name: VoxConverse: Audio-Visual Speaker Diarisation in the Wild
description: VoxConverse is an audio-visual speaker diarization benchmark captured in unconstrained real-world environments. Curated by the Visual Geometry Group (VGG) at Oxford, it contains over 56 hours of conversational speech drawn from political debates, panel discussions, interviews, and news broadcasts with challenging overlap conditions, variable acoustic environments, and varied speaker head poses.
